name: Saint (Prestige Class)
body:
Sanctity is the ideal state to attain for a contemplative character, regardless of her vocation. A saint meditates, follows ascetic practices, and pledges to creeds of virtue to attain the perfect union with her god, striving to reach an even greater perfection, according to the ideals of her faith. Often, she belongs to a priestly order, living and praying in a community of like-minded worshipers of the same god. Though many saints are peaceful souls, this is not a requirement: a saint of the Goddess of War could well be a grim, obsessed Holy Vindicator who strengthens her determination by following strict creeds of abstinence, chastity, and obedience.

Saints mostly worship good deities or demi-deities; a saint can pledge herself to a neutral god, but such an eventuality is rare.

Hit Die: d8.

Requirements

To qualify to become a saint, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any good.
Deity: Must worship a single, specific deity.
Feats: Virtuous Creed.
Skills: Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.
Spells: Ability to cast 3rd-level divine spells.
Class Skills

The saint’s class skills (and the key ability for each skill) are Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Fly (Dex), Handle Animal (Wis), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (religion, Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Survival (Wis).

Skill Points per Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Table: Saint
Level	BaB	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells
1st	+0	+0	+0	+1	Aura of good, obedience, saint’s charism, sensorial presence 1/day	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
3rd	+1	+1	+1	+2	Saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
4th	+2	+1	+1	+2	Divine boon 1, saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
5th	+2	+2	+2	+3	Saint’s charism, sensorial presence 2/day	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
6th	+3	+2	+2	+3	Saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
7th	+3	+2	+2	+4	Divine boon 2, saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
8th	+4	+3	+3	+4	Saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
9th	+4	+3	+3	+5	Saint’s charism	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
10th	+5	+3	+3	+5	Divine boon 3, proxy ascension, sensorial presence 3/day	+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
Class Features

The following are class features of the saint prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Saints gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day/Spells Known

At the indicated levels, a saint gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class to which she belonged before taking the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If the character had more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming a saint, she must decide to which class she adds the new level for the purposes of determining spells per day.

Aura of Good (Ex)

A saint’s aura of good (see the detect good spell) functions as that of a cleric whose level is equal to the saint’s character level. If a saint already has an aura of good from another class, the effects stack.

Obedience (Ex)

At 1st level, a saint gains Deific Obedience or another obedience feat appropriated for her deity. If she already has such a feat, she gains the continued service charisma instead. In order to maintain the abilities granted by this prestige class, a saint must perform a daily obedience to her chosen deity. If a saint takes the Deific Obedience feat for the first time when entering this prestige class, she can choose whether to receive evangelist, exalted, or sentinel boons.

Saint’s Charism

Saints are recognizable from other worshipers because of the charisms, or special gifts, that their god grants them as a sign of election. A saint gains a new charism at every class level from 1st to 9th. The saint cannot select the same charism more than once, unless specified.

Bilocation (Su)

You can physically appear in two places at the same time. This basically works as a project image spell, except that you may form your double in any place near a creature you’re familiar with (as with a sending). The image is tangible and can eat, drink and move objects, but may only cast divination spells; it cannot use class abilities, attack, or deliver objects (unless you use teleport spells to deliver an object to the receiver). Your double lasts a number of rounds per day equal to your saint level + your Charisma modifier. These rounds must not be consecutive.

Bonus Feat

You gain a bonus feat. This must be a channeling feat, an item creation feat, a metamagic feat, or a feat that has an obedience feat as a prerequisite. You must meet the selected feat’s prerequisites. The GM can add other feats to the list, depending on your deity’s portfolio and granted domains. This charism can be selected more than once; you must select a different feat each time.

Continued Service

Choose one of the following class features: animal companion, bane, bardic performance, blessings, channel energy, divine bond, domain, judgment, oracle curse, revelations, sacred weapon, smite evil, shaman spirit, or spirit animal. You add your saint class levels to your effective class level in one class of your choice for the purpose of determining the effects of the chosen class feature. This charism can be selected more than once; you must select a different class feature each time.

Detect Lies (Sp)

You gain the discern lies ability as an inquisitor of your saint level. If you already possess this ability, your saint level stacks with your inquisitor level for determining the number of rounds per day you can use it.

Exorcism (Su)

Once per day, you can touch a possessed creature, giving it a new Will save to free itself from its condition. The creature is granted a bonus on this save equal to half your saint level. If the save is successful, the effect is dispelled and the possessor is forced to return to its original body and/or home plane.

Fasting (Ex)

You can resist without eating or drinking for a number of days equal to your saint level.

Gift of Tongues (Ex)

You can communicate with every living being as per the tongue of the sun and moon monk power.

Imbue Spells to Objects (Su)

You may cast any one spell from the schools of abjuration or conjuration (healing) on an object without immediate effect, to be released at a later time. The level of this spell can be up to 1/2 the highest level you can cast, rounded down. The object effectively becomes a single-use proto-relic. The spell can be stored in the object indefinitely, even after your death. It activates when a devout worshiper of your same deity or philosophy, other than you, uses the object (wears your socks, prays with your prayer beads, or raises your shield). You cannot benefit from your own spells stored in objects, and you cannot have more than one such object at a time per saint level you possess. Once the spell is discharged, the object can never be used this way again.

Levitate (Su)

You can use the flight hex as a witch of your saint level. If you already possess this hex, your effective witch level stacks with your saint level for determining its use.

Prophecy (Su)

You gain the wisdom of the ancestors revelation from the Ancestor mystery as an oracle of your saint level. If you already possess this power, your effective oracle level stacks with your saint level for determining its use.

Seer (Sp)

You gain the remote viewing power of the Knowledge domain as a cleric of your saint level. If you already possess this power, your effective cleric level stacks with your saint level for determining its use.

Stigmata (Su)

You gain the stigmata ability of the holy vindicator prestige class. If you have levels in holy vindicator, the two abilities don’t stack; you must activate each one separately.

Telepathy (Su)

You gain the read minds power of the Thought subdomain as a cleric of your saint level. If you already possess this power, your effective cleric level stacks with your saint level for determining its use. The DC of the Will save against this power is Charisma-based.

Thaumaturgy (Su)

You gain the lay on hands or touch of corruption power as a paladin or antipaladin of your saint level. If you already possess this ability, your saint level stack with your paladin or antipaladin level for the purposes of this power. You may select this charism more than once: you can choose a mercy or a cruelty every time you select this ability after the first, as if you were a paladin or antipaladin of the same level.

Transfiguration (Sp)

You can use lesser proxy aspect once per day as a spell-like ability. At 5th level, you can take this charism a second time to make this ability function as proxy aspect 2/day; at 9th level, you can select it a third time to make this ability function as greater proxy aspect 3/day.

Virtuous Pledge (Ex)

You gain Virtuous Creed as a bonus feat. This Charisma can be selected more than once; you must select a different creed every time.

Voice of Conscience (Sp)

You can cast the preserve grace spell at will as a spell-like ability.

Wake In Prayer (Ex)

You can resist without sleep for a number of days equal to your saint level. You still need to meditate for 1 hour in order to regain spells and heal your wounds.

Sensorial Presence (Su)

Saints are given sensorial signs that identify them as chosen by the divine. Be it a supernatural light in darkness, celestial perfumes, or a tingling of heavenly bells, a saint chooses a sensorial effect to add to her aura of good, which will make other worshipers aware of her presence. A saint can activate or deactivate this sensorial effect at will. Whenever the saint casts a spell or uses a divine class ability while her sensorial effect is activated, the target of the spell, or all creatures in its area of effect, can experience the sensorial presence of the saint. Those casting divination spells on the saint to perceive his aura while the sensorial effect is activated automatically perceive the effect too. Once per day, the saint can affect creatures that can perceive her sensorial effect with calm emotions if they are good or neutral, or cause fear if they are evil. The saint can use this ability one more time per day at 5th and 10th level.

Divine Boon

As the saint gains levels, she gains boons from her chosen deity. The nature of these boons varies depending on the saint’s chosen deity. Each deity grants three boons, each more powerful than the last. At 4th level, the saint gains the first boon. At 7th level, she gains the second boon, and at 10th level, she gains the third boon. Consult the obedience feat your character possesses and her deity’s description for details on these divine boons. When a divine boon grants a spell-like ability, the saint’s caster level for the spell-like ability equals her total character level. This ability allows a saint to access these boons earlier than with an obedience feat alone; it does not grant additional uses of the boons once the character reaches the necessary Hit Dice to earn the boons normally.

Proxy Ascension

At 10th level, a saint gains perfect union with her god. Her type changes to outsider (native), with subtypes fitting his alignment. If she dies, she is instantly affected by a sanctification spell. The saint can decide to leave his body behind when ascending to the planes of good; if she does so, her body receives a permanent gentle repose spell (no save). Lastly, the saint may cast miracle once per day. This ability does not require a material component, but the miracle cannot be used to grant ability score bonuses, nor can it be used to replicate spells with expensive material components.
